title: Provision Secure and Scalable Cloud Environment
description: As a System Architect, I want to provision a secure, multi-AZ AWS infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code (CDK), so that the application has a high-availability foundation that isolates sensitive data and scales with user load.
business_value: Ensures 99.9% system availability and regulatory compliance through strict network isolation (VPC) and encryption at rest, reducing operational risk and manual provisioning errors.
acceptance_criteria: [{"scenario":"Network Isolation Verification","given":"The CDK network stack has been deployed","when":"A network security audit is performed","then":"The VPC should span 2 Availability Zones, and the Aurora Database and Redis clusters must only be accessible from private subnets, blocked from public internet access."},{"scenario":"Compute Auto-Scaling","given":"The Compute stack is active with Fargate services running","when":"CPU utilization exceeds 70% for a sustained period","then":"The ECS Auto Scaling group should automatically provision additional task instances to handle the load."},{"scenario":"Storage Security","given":"S3 buckets and Database clusters are provisioned","when":"Configuration is inspected","then":"All data at rest must be encrypted using AWS KMS keys, and public access blocks must be enabled on all S3 buckets."}]
technical_tasks: ["WI-INFRA-001: Define Networking & VPC Stack","WI-INFRA-002: Provision Database & Storage Resources","WI-INFRA-003: Configure Compute & API Gateway"]
definition_of_done: ["CDK stacks (Network, Data, Compute) synthesize and deploy without errors","Security groups verified to allow traffic only on required ports (443, 5432, 6379)","Infrastructure state file is stored securely in S3 with locking"]

title: Automated Cross-Platform CI/CD Pipelines
description: As a DevOps Engineer, I want to implement automated CI/CD pipelines for both Backend and Mobile applications, so that code changes are automatically tested, built, and securely deployed to production/store tracks without manual intervention.
business_value: Accelerates time-to-market for features and bug fixes while enforcing quality gates (testing) and reducing deployment failures caused by human error.
acceptance_criteria: [{"scenario":"Backend Deployment Automation","given":"A developer pushes code to the 'main' branch","when":"The GitHub Action workflow triggers","then":"The system must run xUnit tests, build the Docker container, push to ECR, and update the Fargate service via CDK deployment."},{"scenario":"Mobile Release Automation","given":"A release tag is pushed to the repository","when":"The Mobile Release workflow triggers","then":"Fastlane must build signed IPA and AAB artifacts and upload them to TestFlight and Google Play Console Internal Track respectively."}]
technical_tasks: ["WI-DEVOPS-001: Backend CI/CD Pipeline Implementation","WI-DEVOPS-002: Mobile App Build & Release Pipeline"]
definition_of_done: ["Pipelines successfully run end-to-end for both stacks","Signing certificates and secrets are securely retrieved from GitHub Secrets","Failed tests block the deployment process"]

title: Seamless Session Management with Token Refresh
description: As an App User, I want my login session to persist securely via automated token refreshing, so that I am not forced to log in repeatedly while using the app.
business_value: Significantly improves user retention and experience by removing friction (login screens) while maintaining high security standards via short-lived access tokens.
acceptance_criteria: [{"scenario":"Auto-refresh on Token Expiration","given":"The user's access token has expired but the refresh token is valid","when":"The user initiates an API request","then":"The Dio interceptor must pause the request, successfully refresh the token with Auth0, and retry the original request transparently to the user."},{"scenario":"Concurrent Request Handling","given":"Multiple API requests are fired simultaneously while the token is expired","when":"The refresh process is initiated","then":"Only one refresh request should be sent, and all pending requests should be queued and retried once the new token is available."},{"scenario":"Secure Logout on Invalid Refresh","given":"The user's refresh token is invalid or revoked","when":"The app attempts to refresh the token","then":"The system must clear local secure storage and redirect the user to the Login screen."}]
technical_tasks: ["WI-AUTH-004: Implement Token Refresh & Interceptor","WI-AUTH-001: Implement JWT Authentication Middleware"]
definition_of_done: ["Dio interceptor unit tested with mocked 401 responses","Token refresh logic handles race conditions","Access tokens are never stored in plain text/SharedPreferences"]

title: Secure Google Books API Proxy
description: As a Security Officer, I want all external book searches to be proxied through our backend infrastructure, so that our API keys are never exposed to the client application and we can enforce rate limiting.
business_value: Prevents API key theft and quota abuse, ensuring service continuity and preventing unexpected costs from the Google Books API.
acceptance_criteria: [{"scenario":"Book Search Proxy","given":"A user searches for a book title in the app","when":"The request reaches the backend","then":"The backend must inject the server-side API key, call Google Books API, and return normalized DTOs to the client."},{"scenario":"Resilience and Caching","given":"The Google Books API is experiencing downtime or high latency","when":"A search request is made","then":"The system should utilize the Circuit Breaker pattern (Polly) to fail fast, or return cached results from Redis if available."}]
definition_of_done: ["Endpoint deployed and secured behind JWT auth","API Key is stored in AWS Secrets Manager (not code)","Polly policies configured for Retry and Circuit Break"]

title: Robust Offline Data Synchronization
description: As a Mobile User, I want my reading data to sync automatically between my device and the cloud, including changes made while offline, so that my progress is never lost and is consistent across devices.
business_value: Delivers the 'Offline-First' core promise of the application, ensuring usability in poor network conditions and data integrity.
acceptance_criteria: [{"scenario":"Sync Offline Changes","given":"The user has modified book progress while in Airplane mode","when":"Network connectivity is restored","then":"The Background Sync Service must detect the connection and push all 'dirty' records to the backend batch endpoint."},{"scenario":"Conflict Resolution","given":"The same record was modified on the server and the device","when":"Synchronization occurs","then":"The system must apply the 'Last-Write-Wins' strategy based on UTC timestamps to resolve the conflict."},{"scenario":"Local Data Persistence","given":"The app is installed fresh on a new device","when":"The user logs in","then":"The sync service must pull the user's full library and history from the backend and populate the local Isar database."}]
technical_tasks: ["WI-CORE-001: Implement Isar Local Database Schema","WI-CORE-002: Develop Background Sync Service","WI-CORE-004: Implement Library Sync Endpoints"]
definition_of_done: ["Integration tests verifying sync scenarios (offline -> online)","Batch processing implemented for network efficiency","Isar schema migration strategy defined"]

title: Automated User Context Vectorization
description: As a Premium User, I want my reading history and preferences to be analyzed daily to generate a personalized 'taste profile', so that the recommendations I receive are highly relevant to my evolving interests.
business_value: Enables the core premium value proposition (AI Recommendations) by ensuring the underlying data model is fresh and searchable, directly driving subscription retention.
acceptance_criteria: [{"scenario":"Daily Context Update","given":"The user has logged new reading sessions today","when":"The nightly Hangfire job executes","then":"The system must aggregate the user's history, generate a new vector embedding via OpenAI API, and update the OpenSearch index."},{"scenario":"Idempotent Execution","given":"The background job is triggered multiple times or retried after failure","when":"It processes the same user","then":"It must ensure only one valid embedding vector exists per user/day to prevent data duplication and wasted API costs."}]
technical_tasks: ["WI-AI-001: Implement Embedding Generation Job","WI-INFRA-004: Setup Asynchronous Processing Infrastructure"]
definition_of_done: ["Hangfire dashboard shows successful job execution","Vectors verified in OpenSearch dashboard","OpenAI API rate limiting handling confirmed"]
